audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Joshua / Yehoshua cities-of-refuge implementation narrative, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for Deuteronomy/Numbers refuge command, unintentional killing, blood-avenger restraint, gate hearing, trial before congregation, high-priest death marker, six named refuge cities, and equal access for Israelite, sojourner, and resident alien.

familiar.text: The LORD also spake unto Joshua, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Joshua,

verses.restored: Speak to children of Israel, saying, Give for yourselves cities of refuge of which I spoke to you by hand of Moses,

familiar.text: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Appoint out for you cities of refuge, whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses:

modern.text: “Tell the Israelites to designate the cities of refuge, as I instructed you through Moses,

original.text: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר תְּנ֤וּ לָכֶם֙ אֶת עָרֵ֣י הַמִּקְלָ֔ט אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם בְּיַד מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: so a manslayer who strikes a soul/life by mistake, without knowledge, may flee there; they shall be for you refuge from blood-avenger.

familiar.text: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.

modern.text: so that anyone who kills another unintentionally or accidentally may flee there. These will be your refuge from the avenger of blood.

original.text: לָנ֥וּס שָׁ֨מָּה֙ רוֹצֵ֔חַ מַכֵּה נֶ֥פֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָ֖ה בִּבְלִי דָ֑עַת וְהָי֤וּ לָכֶם֙ לְמִקְלָ֔ט מִגֹּאֵ֖ל הַדָּֽם

verses.restored: He shall flee to one of these cities, stand at entrance of gate of city, and speak his words in ears of elders of that city; they shall gather him into city to them and give him a place, and he shall dwell with them.

familiar.text: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city, and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city, they shall take him into the city unto them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.

modern.text: When someone flees to one of these cities, stands at the entrance of the city gate, and states his case before its elders, they are to bring him into the city and give him a place to live among them.

original.text: וְנָ֞ס אֶל אַחַ֣ת מֵהֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה וְעָמַד֙ פֶּ֚תַח שַׁ֣עַר הָעִ֔יר וְדִבֶּ֛ר בְּאָזְנֵ֛י זִקְנֵ֥י הָעִֽיר הַהִ֖יא אֶת דְּבָרָ֑יו וְאָסְפ֨וּ אֹת֤וֹ הָעִ֨ירָה֙ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְנָתְנוּ ל֥וֹ מָק֖וֹם וְיָשַׁ֥ב עִמָּֽם

verses.restored: If blood-avenger pursues after him, they shall not deliver manslayer into his hand, because he struck his neighbor without knowledge and did not hate him in time past.

familiar.text: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him, then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand; because he smote his neighbour unwittingly, and hated him not beforetime.

modern.text: Now if the avenger of blood pursues him, they must not surrender the manslayer into his hand, because that man killed his neighbor accidentally without prior malice.

original.text: וְכִ֨י יִרְדֹּ֜ף גֹּאֵ֤ל הַדָּם֙ אַֽחֲרָ֔יו וְלֹֽא יַסְגִּ֥רוּ אֶת הָרֹצֵ֖חַ בְּיָד֑וֹ כִּ֤י בִבְלִי דַ֨עַת֙ הִכָּ֣ה אֶת רֵעֵ֔הוּ וְלֹֽא שֹׂנֵ֥א ה֛וּא ל֖וֹ מִתְּמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם

verses.restored: He shall dwell in that city until he stands before congregation for judgment, until death of high priest who is in those days. Then manslayer shall return and come to his own city and to his house, to city from which he fled.

familiar.text: And he shall dwell in that city, until he stand before the congregation for judgment, and until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days: then shall the slayer return, and come unto his own city, and unto his own house, unto the city from whence he fled.

modern.text: He is to stay in that city until he stands trial before the assembly and until the death of the high priest serving at that time. Then the manslayer may return to his own home in the city from which he fled.”

original.text: וְיָשַׁ֣ב בָּעִ֣יר הַהִ֗יא עַד עָמְד֞וֹ לִפְנֵ֤י הָֽעֵדָה֙ לַמִּשְׁפָּ֔ט עַד מוֹת֙ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֑ם אָ֣ז יָשׁ֣וּב הָרוֹצֵ֗חַ וּבָ֤א אֶל עִירוֹ֙ וְאֶל בֵּית֔וֹ אֶל הָעִ֖יר אֲשֶׁר נָ֥ס מִשָּֽׁם

verses.restored: They set apart Kedesh in Galilee in hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath-arba, that is Hebron, in hill country of Judah.

familiar.text: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali, and Shechem in mount Ephraim, and Kirjatharba, which is Hebron, in the mountain of Judah.

modern.text: So they set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.

original.text: וַיַּקְדִּ֜שׁוּ אֶת קֶ֤דֶשׁ בַּגָּלִיל֙ בְּהַ֣ר נַפְתָּלִ֔י וְאֶת שְׁכֶ֖ם בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְאֶת קִרְיַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֛ע הִ֥יא חֶבְר֖וֹן בְּהַ֥ר יְהוּדָֽה

verses.restored: Across Jordan by Jericho eastward they gave Bezer in wilderness on plateau from tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead from tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan from tribe of Manasseh.

familiar.text: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

modern.text: And beyond the Jordan, east of Jericho, they designated Bezer on the wilderness plateau from the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead from the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan from the tribe of Manasseh.

original.text: וּמֵעֵ֜בֶר לְיַרְדֵּ֤ן יְרִיחוֹ֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה נָתְנ֞וּ אֶת בֶּ֧צֶר בַּמִּדְבָּ֛ר בַּמִּישֹׁ֖ר מִמַּטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֑ן וְאֶת רָאמֹ֤ת בַּגִּלְעָד֙ מִמַּטֵּה גָ֔ד וְאֶת גלון בַּבָּשָׁ֖ן מִמַּטֵּ֥ה מְנַשֶּֽׁה

verses.restored: These were cities appointed for all children of Israel and for sojourner and resident alien among them, so anyone striking a soul/life by mistake might flee there and not die by hand of blood-avenger until he stands before congregation.

familiar.text: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them, that whosoever killeth any person at unawares might flee thither, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation.

modern.text: These are the cities appointed for all the Israelites and foreigners among them, so that anyone who kills a person unintentionally may flee there and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood prior to standing trial before the assembly.

original.text: אֵ֣לֶּה הָיוּ֩ עָרֵ֨י הַמּֽוּעָדָ֜ה לְכֹ֣ל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְלַגֵּר֙ הַגָּ֣ר בְּתוֹכָ֔ם לָנ֣וּס שָׁ֔מָּה כָּל מַכֵּה נֶ֖פֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָ֑ה וְלֹ֣א יָמ֗וּת בְּיַד֙ גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּ֔ם עַד עָמְד֖וֹ לִפְנֵ֥י הָעֵדָֽה

translation_notes: Joshua 20 implements refuge legislation anticipated in Exodus, Numbers, and Deuteronomy, with emphasis on unintentional killing and protection from immediate revenge.
Refuge begins at the city gate with a preliminary hearing before elders, not with vigilante capture.
The city must receive the fugitive, give him a place, and not hand him over to the blood-avenger when the killing was without knowledge and without prior hatred.
The blood-avenger institution is restrained by asylum and trial but remains an ancient kinship-vengeance system, not a modern justice model.
The killer remains in refuge until trial and, in this version, until the high priest's death; that marker requires comparison with Numbers 35 and later interpretation.
The six cities cover west and east of Jordan and include access for Israelite, sojourner, and resident alien alike.
This refuge structure protects accused people without declaring every killing harmless; intent and due process matter.
safety_note: Do not use Joshua 20 to justify private vengeance, sanctuary for intentional murder, indefinite detention without process, or unequal access to asylum. Center reachable refuge, gate hearing, protection from hot retaliation, intent analysis, and equal access for citizens and immigrants.
